Tmax-guided shrinkage between all-X Ridge and all-X MCP estimators

Source: R/fit-ridge-mcp-shrinkage.R
fit_ridge_mcp_shrinkage.Rd

fit_ridge_mcp_shrinkage() uses every design column in both endpoints. The dense full-model endpoint is Ridge, computed through an n by n dual system, and the sparse-model endpoint is an MCP fit whose support is selected from the data. No true active set or prespecified zero block is imposed on the MCP optimization. The coordinate set supplied in tested_set is used only by an auxiliary debiased square-root-LASSO maximum test.

Usage

fit_ridge_mcp_shrinkage(
  X,
  y,
  tested_set,
  t = NULL,
  ridge_lambda = NULL,
  ridge_lambda_grid = NULL,
  mcp_lambda = NULL,
  mcp_lambda_grid = NULL,
  mcp_gamma = 3,
  mcp_ebic_gamma = 0.5,
  mcp_nlambda = 60L,
  mcp_lambda_min_ratio = 0.01,
  mcp_beta_init = NULL,
  mcp_max_iter = 5000L,
  mcp_tol = 1e-07,
  mcp_zero_tol = 1e-08,
  test_lambda = NULL,
  precision = c("nodewise", "diagonal", "user"),
  lambda_node = NULL,
  theta_rows = NULL,
  precision_fit = NULL,
  assume_independent = FALSE,
  alpha = 0.05,
  bootstrap_B = 999L,
  bootstrap_seed = NULL,
  bootstrap_multipliers = NULL,
  bootstrap_block_size = 256L,
  pilot_beta_init = NULL,
  pilot_operator_norm = NULL,
  pilot_max_iter = 30000L,
  pilot_tol = 5e-06,
  pilot_check_every = 50L,
  epsilon = 1e-10
)

Arguments

X

Numeric n by p design matrix.

y

Numeric response vector.

tested_set

One-based coordinates in the null hypothesis.

t

Coordinatewise null target; defaults to zero.

ridge_lambda

Optional fixed Ridge penalty.

ridge_lambda_grid

Positive Ridge grid selected by GCV when ridge_lambda is NULL. GCV counts the unpenalized intercept in its effective degrees of freedom.

mcp_lambda

Optional fixed MCP penalty.

mcp_lambda_grid

Decreasing MCP grid selected by EBIC when mcp_lambda is NULL.

mcp_gamma

MCP concavity parameter; the default is 3.

mcp_ebic_gamma

EBIC combinatorial-penalty multiplier.

mcp_nlambda

Number of automatically generated MCP penalties.

mcp_lambda_min_ratio

Smallest automatic MCP penalty relative to the zero-solution penalty.

mcp_beta_init

Optional original-scale MCP warm start. It never encodes or accepts an active set.

mcp_max_iter

Maximum coordinate-descent sweeps per path point.

mcp_tol

MCP convergence tolerance.

mcp_zero_tol

Numerical support threshold.

test_lambda

Square-root-LASSO penalty used only for the test pilot.

precision

Precision-direction method for the test pilot.

lambda_node

Nodewise-LASSO penalty when applicable.

theta_rows

Optional user precision rows.

precision_fit

Optional reusable precision fit for tested_set.

assume_independent

Required for diagonal precision.

alpha

Test level.

bootstrap_B

Number of multiplier-bootstrap draws.

bootstrap_seed

Optional bootstrap seed.

bootstrap_multipliers

Optional reusable multiplier matrix.

bootstrap_block_size

Bootstrap block size.

pilot_beta_init

Optional original-scale square-root-LASSO warm start.

pilot_operator_norm

Optional reusable design operator norm.

pilot_max_iter

Maximum pilot iterations.

pilot_tol

Pilot convergence tolerance.

pilot_check_every

Pilot diagnostic interval.

epsilon

Numerical floor in the Stein weight.

Value

An hd_shrinkage_fit object whose FM endpoint is Ridge and whose SM endpoint is the data-adaptive all-X MCP estimate. PPS is reported separately from PS: it equals FM after rejection and PS otherwise.

Details

With centered, standardized data, the full endpoint is $$\hat\beta^{FM}=X^T(XX^T+n\lambda_R I_n)^{-1}y.$$ The sparse endpoint minimizes $$\|y-Xb\|_2^2/(2n)+\sum_j p_{\lambda_M,\gamma}^{MCP}(|b_j|).$$ The test pilot is deliberately separate from both risk endpoints so that Ridge bias is not used to calibrate the high-dimensional null test. Max-Stein risk dominance is not asserted.

Examples

set.seed(1)
X <- matrix(rnorm(40 * 80), 40, 80)
beta <- c(1.2, -1, 0.8, rep(0, 77))
y <- drop(X %*% beta + rnorm(40))
fit <- fit_ridge_mcp_shrinkage(
  X, y, tested_set = 4:80,
  precision = "diagonal", assume_independent = TRUE,
  bootstrap_B = 99, mcp_nlambda = 20,
  pilot_max_iter = 5000, pilot_tol = 1e-4
)
coef(fit, method = "PS")
coef(fit, method = "PPS")
